name: settings.return_to_dial.selected_description
evidence: The page creator stores its root in 0x20111c90 before building the list. The row builder reads persist.back_dial_id, selects the matching row, formats return_to_dial_info.settings into a stack buffer and passes that buffer and its newly-created label to the label-text veneer. The destroy callback clears the page root. The label is local, so dispatch uses the exact call site and active root, not a subject slot. Selection and language callbacks rebuild the list.
scope: the description of the selected return-to-dial setting while the page is active
